bookCandidatePicker.title.description: Sheet header asking the user to identify which book was scanned

bookCandidatePicker.cancel.description: Button label to dismiss the book picker sheet without selecting

bookCandidatePicker.closePicker.description: Accessibility label for the dismiss button on the picker sheet

bookCandidatePicker.selectBook.description: Accessibility label for a book candidate card. {{title}} and {{author}} are dynamic.

bookCandidatePicker.addToWishlistHint.description: Accessibility hint explaining that tapping a book card adds it to the wishlist

bookCandidatePicker.alreadyOwned.description: Badge label shown on book cards already in the user's library

bookCandidatePicker.noneOfThese.description: Button label at the bottom of the picker to dismiss without selecting any book

bookCandidatePicker.noneOfTheseA11y.description: Accessibility label for the none-of-these button

themeToggle.toDark.description: Accessibility label for the theme toggle button when currently in light mode

themeToggle.toLight.description: Accessibility label for the theme toggle button when currently in dark mode

bookCandidatePicker.ownedSameEdition.description: Note on a scan or search result the user already has in this exact edition (same ISBN); the book can't be added again

bookCandidatePicker.ownedOtherEdition.description: Note on a scan or search result whose title the user already has, but in a different edition; the book can't be added again

bookCandidatePicker.ownedEditionUnknown.description: Note on a scan or search result the user already has when the edition can't be compared (no ISBN); same text as ownedSameEdition

bookCandidatePicker.notInCatalog.description: Note on a scan result that no catalog (Open Library / Google Books) matched.

bookCandidatePicker.addYourself.description: Button on a scan result with no catalog match: opens a form to add the book yourself as an unverified entry.

bookCandidatePicker.addYourselfA11y.description: Accessibility label for the Add it yourself button. {{title}} is the book title.

addUnverified.title.description: Header of the form for adding a book the catalog could not find.

addUnverified.intro.description: Explains the form: the book was not found; check the details; only the user sees it, marked Unverified.

addUnverified.titleLabel.description: Label of the book title field.

addUnverified.isbnLabel.description: Label of the optional ISBN field.

addUnverified.saveHint.description: Accessibility hint of the Save button.

addUnverified.cancel.description: Button that closes the form without saving.

addUnverified.closeA11y.description: Accessibility label of the Cancel button.

addUnverified.titleRequired.description: Error shown when the title field is empty.

addUnverified.authorRequired.description: Error shown when the author field is empty.

addUnverified.isbnInvalid.description: Error when the server rejects the ISBN.

addUnverified.invalid.description: Error when the server rejects the details for another reason.

addUnverified.duplicate.description: Error (409 unverified_duplicate): the user already added this book themselves.

addUnverified.limitReached.description: Error (409 unverified_limit_reached): the user holds the maximum number of books added themselves.

addUnverified.failed.description: Error when saving failed for an unknown reason (network, server).
